segments.en: Hello.
Hi.
Hi, Elinda.
I am from Bangalore. What about you?
I am from Bangalore too.
Oh wow. Where in Bangalore?
Andranagar.
Okay, okay. I used to live in Jayanagar, Bangalore.
Ah, nice.
So, what is the news?
Tell me, what have you been doing?
Nothing much. I have a business, that is all.
What business?
Sorry?
What business? Just tell me.
I have a sketching business.
Okay, okay, okay. Nice. What is your name?
Shreya.
Oh, very nice. Nice name.
How about you? What do you do?
Shreyas, it should be Shreyas always.
Let's see.
And what do you do?
I am a businessman. I manufacture fabrics.
Okay, nice.
One minute, one minute, one minute.
Tell me.
What else?
You have to tell me, Shreyas.
It is not Shreyas, my name is Shreya.
Shreya, okay, okay, Shreya. Okay, that is it. I just put Shreyas so that it comes up.
Shreyas is a boy's name, I know.
Okay, nice. Okay, okay. Shreya, you have to tell me, Shreya.
So, why are you using this app at this time?
Basically, there are two things.
One, I had a major fight with my wife.
I came here for a holiday, meaning I came to Coimbatore for business. I will return tomorrow night.
To get rid of the tension, I just came on the app. It is good that I came here, it has been a while.
Okay.
The second thing?
Sorry?
You said there are mainly two reasons. You said the first one, what is the second one?
The second one is that I am feeling sleepy.
Oh, okay.
Nice.
What about you?
Nothing much. I am feeling sleepy too.
And although I was having a little fun from people, crazy people. Fun in the sense, not any sexual fun. Very different kind of fun, very verbal.
No, no, not like that.
No, no, I am just describing to you because if you misunderstand, 90% of people come to this app for that reason.
Oh, probably. I don't know.
Okay.
Okay, I don't know if you have used the app enough, but yeah, 90% of...
It has been 30-35 minutes since I used this app. I will just delete it, that is all.
Okay, so you have already seen the aunties, right?
No. I just check some profile, it will match your profile, it will match your profile, I click on it, it comes, it goes, it comes, it goes. Something or other came, and I thought, oh my god, enough.

At this time, no one will be there. At night time, poor aunties, their husbands will have come. If you want to find someone, they will come in the morning time, they will send their husbands to work, and then they will come to this app and sit naked.
I see. I am not interested in any naked...
That is exactly what happens in this app. You won't find anybody in the night time, but you will find people in the day.
You use it one time in the day. Why are you using this app? Just click and delete it, why are you wasting your time?
I want to do it now only, sometimes.
That is it.
So, no, I am talking to you, meaning you are awake, no?
Sorry?
You are awake, no, at this time?

Yeah, yeah, I am awake because I don't have any husband that I should be afraid of. I don't want money, I have enough money for life. I don't have any things like that. I am awake because I want to, that is all.
So 90%, you are 10%.
Of course.
Nice.

There is some guy who will come, he will tell... he will ask, what do you talk with guys? Then I tell him, if someone comes with a bad head, I will hurt their ego and send them away. I was just playing with him, okay? And then he was like, bro, you are such an asshole, bro, he said. I got very pissed. I told him, how dare you call me like that? And then he was like, okay, leave it, my ego will not get hurt, my ego is not small, he said. He said it, and in five seconds, he cut the call and went away.
I don't know what kind of people are coming to this app.
I am taking fun out of it, that is all. I am not taking any shit seriously.
Good, good. I am just... but you are... what you want, that is all. I don't care about anything else.

See, I really don't want anything from this app. First, I was using this app as a customer. I saw the faces of these aunties, I saw the faces of ghosts, I saw them, and then I shifted to this side. Let's see how the boys are.
And in that, this is easy. The boys, okay, fine. Some of them talk well, some of them, they will come naked, guys also come naked.
So, but comparatively, it is better.
So, what happened? You and your wife fought? Who did not agree?
No, no, no, leave it. On this, I cannot say anything, I cannot, leave it.
Nothing has happened, I am happy.
Why, what happened, bro? Just now you said you guys fought.
No, till now, I have... I thought I have a problem. I have got... I can see someone who has got a problem than me. So, I have no issues.
Oh, that is you only.
What problem do I have?
You have a problem in this app. You are finding so many people, you have so much of problems.
Bro, what the fuck are you saying? I don't have any problem. I am talking to people for two hours straight.
Okay, okay.
Yeah, I am just time passing, that is all.
And some nice people get connected, they talk to me for such a long time. What problem do I have?
You will understand why I am telling this. You use it in the morning time, or else you will delete the app and go.
I will delete the app and go, I will just finish that money whatever I loaded.
Better.
I know, I got an offer. If I give 2000 rupees, I will get 5000 coins. This is not a good jackpot, I recharged it. I will just empty it, that is all.
Bro, how will 5000 coins get empty like that?
For one, for one second or something, 10 coins will go.

Yeah, there is one lady who came, so I tell her, what I have to show, sir, tell me where I have to show, sir, give me your WhatsApp number, give me this, give me that. I said, boss, I have not come to give you my WhatsApp number, I just came to talk. I just wanted to share something, and the moment I was talking, only she started opening her top.
I said, one minute, and she says, sir, I cannot open the top for a long time because it will get disconnected. You please give me your WhatsApp number.
I know all this happens.
I just pressed it to disconnect, that is all.
I know, I know, but this app is filled with that.
So you also...
Sorry?
You also had a nice experience, then.
Nice experience, meaning?
Meaning, the boys have all irritated me well, that is what.
Yeah, yeah, they will come, they will keep everything ready, and I will not even look for two seconds, I will cut the call and go away, that is all.
Okay, okay.

So, one app means there will be good things, there will be bad things. If I am benefiting from this app, if I am having a peace of mind, why will I let some assholes ruin my peace of mind? They come, it is not good, I cut the call and go away, that is all.
That is nice, that is nice.
It was nice talking to you, Shreya.
It was nice talking to you too.
So, good night.
Good night.
